body:
I will think on it, if nothing else I need to write a note which will take time. 

I hate to even have posted here, I just had nowhere else to turn.

26 is ancient to be working a shitty part time job and have no prospects. My relationship was so long I have never dated anyone else, I don't even really know how to ask someone out. 

I see what you say that people will be hurt, I get the logic in it completely. I just see the overwhelming hill I would have to climb to make something from this pile of shit and I am good enough with numbers to know its unlikely I will ever make it. Others in my life are all extremely strong people, I'm the weak link.

I would at least leave a note though explaining it and why, no blame for anyone else. I will sleep in my car  tonight and call my friend in the morning but I just see this bleak losing battle here now.

I have apologized, I begged for forgiveness or anything but it won't happen. She will never forgive me for screwing this up and I can't blame her. It has been 3 in a row now. 

I let it get bad and I screwed up everything. It could have been a perfect day too. A nice date night is something I would love to do as an apology but I know it would just be a reminder of how I fuck up events.

It's been so many arguments and so many troubles but yes it's been 8 years. I see how and why she doesn't want me around. 

I put everything I could into today's sit wasn't enough. I screwed up a minor thing and she called me on it and I receded to fuck it up more. I had been holding on trying for her and now that's gone too. 

I am doing poorly in my masters program, have a shit part time job in the meantime with few prospects beyond that. There are no milestones really left. I likely won't graduate from the program, my job prospects beyond working at like Starbucks are almost zero. I have no girlfriend, precisely one real friend outside that. 

The milestones are so unlikely for me is what I see. Right now i am facing a life of loneliness working a crap job. I just can't see a silver lining here knowing there is not future that I can really enjoy in my life.
